The execution failed with `#NAME?` errors in the statistics block (H46:L47). These cells correspond to the 25th and 75th percentiles. The trace shows `expected -14.74024921155005, got #NAME?`. This error typically occurs in Excel/OpenPyXL when using a formula name that is not recognized or requires a prefix. While the task suggested `PERCENTILE` or `PERCENTILE.INC`, some versions of Excel/parsers require `_xlfn.PERCENTILE.INC` or `PERCENTILE` depending on the compatibility mode. 

Additionally, verify if the `MEDIAN` function (H44) also returned `#NAME?`, as it was not explicitly listed in the failed assertions but is part of the same block. The failure in `test_derived_values_and_stats` indicates the logic for calculating or writing the percentile formulas is likely the root cause.
